summary: Creative Global Technology Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, containing the notice of its 2026 Second Extraordinary General Meeting and a proxy card. The EGM is scheduled for September 9, 2026, with the sole proposal being the adoption of the fourth amended and restated memorandum and articles of association, which would revise provisions regarding written resolutions, including eliminating minimum waiting periods and clarifying record dates and effective dates. No financial terms, transaction values, or special-situation elements are present. This is a routine governance and administrative filing, not a special-situation event. The filing does not involve acquisitions, divestitures, activism, strategic reviews, tenders, capital returns, restructuring, or any similar category.
